description: Paid data access. Returns no records itself: it builds the HTTPS query URL for your filters and returns the x402 payment terms (USDC on Base; amsterdam-events $0.005, security-advisories $0.003, vulnerability-watch $0.003, eu-tenders $0.01, uk-tenders $0.005, au-contracts $0.005, eu-funding $0.005, us-grants $0.005, cert-advisories $0.003, eu-medicines $0.005, sanctions-entities $0.005, product-recalls $0.005, eu-legislation $0.005, eu-case-law $0.005, uk-legislation $0.005, us-federal-register $0.005, drug-shortages $0.005, drug-approvals $0.005, public-holidays $0.002, release-calendars $0.003, travel-advisories $0.003, vat-rates $0.002, exchange-rates $0.001, excise-duties $0.002, customs-tariffs $0.002, bond-yields $0.002, policy-rates $0.002, company-identifiers $0.003, company-changes $0.003, competition-cases $0.005, hazard-alerts $0.002, sec-filings $0.003, air-quality $0.003, fuel-prices $0.003, electricity-prices $0.003 per call). Send a GET to http_endpoint with an x402 client (v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or v1 X-PAYMENT header) to receive up to 100 matching records; no account or API key. Filters per dataset: amsterdam-events: from, to, district, q, min_visitors, limit, offset, fields, format; security-advisories: cve, vendor, product, q, added_since, ransomware, min_epss, limit, offset, fields, format; vulnerability-watch: cve, vendor, product, q, min_cvss, kev, updated_since, limit, offset, fields, format; eu-tenders: country, cpv, q, deadline_after, deadline_before, published_since, min_value, nature, scope, region, source, limit, offset, fields, format; uk-tenders: nation, region, cpv, q, buyer, deadline_after, deadline_before, published_since, min_value, category, sme, status, source, limit, offset, fields, format; au-contracts: segment, q, code, buyer, supplier, abn, min_value, max_value, method, published_since, published_before, active_on, limit, offset, fields, format; eu-funding: q, programme, status, type, deadline_after, deadline_before, min_budget, limit, offset, fields, format; us-grants: q, agency, category, eligibility, instrument, status, closing_after, closing_before, posted_since, min_award, limit, offset, fields, format; cert-advisories: cve, vendor, product, q, cert, country, type, severity, updated_since, kev, limit, offset, fields, format; eu-medicines: q, type, category, substance, atc, area, holder, status, flag, shortage, updated_since, limit, offset, fields, format; sanctions-entities: q, list, type, programme, country, identifier, updated_since, limit, offset, fields, format; product-recalls: q, country, authority, source, category, classification, firm, allergen, status, product_code, origin, since, limit, offset, fields, format; eu-legislation: type, author, subject, q, celex, amends, published_since, in_force, limit, offset, fields, format; eu-case-law: court, type, procedure, subject, country, language, q, since, limit, offset, fields, format; uk-legislation: type, legislature, year, number, from, to, in_force_from, in_force_to, extent, subject, q, limit, offset, fields, format; us-federal-register: type, agency, q, published_since, effective_after, comments_close_after, cfr_title, cfr_part, significant, limit, offset, fields, format; drug-shortages: q, substance, country, status, since, source, holder, area, limit, offset, fields, format; drug-approvals: q, regulator, substance, sponsor, type, status, orphan, conditional, year, since, until, limit, offset, fields, format; public-holidays: country, region, date_from, date_to, year, type, q, limit, offset, fields, format; release-calendars: country, agency, status, date_from, date_to, q, limit, offset, fields, format; travel-advisories: destination, issuer, min_level, any_region, changed_since, q, limit, offset, fields, format; vat-rates: country, region, type, cn, q, on_date, limit, offset, fields, format; exchange-rates: publisher, base, quote, currency, date, since, until, latest, limit, offset, fields, format; excise-duties: country, product_category, type, q, on_date, limit, offset, fields, format; customs-tariffs: schedule, code, chapter, measure, q, on_date, limit, offset, fields, format; bond-yields: country, curve, tenor, source, since, until, on_date, latest, limit, offset, fields, format; policy-rates: central_bank, country, currency, since, until, change_type, latest, on_date, limit, offset, fields, format; company-identifiers: lei, q, country, status, change, since, limit, offset, fields, format; company-changes: country, event, legal_form, industry, status, id, q, since, limit, offset, fields, format; competition-cases: authority, case_type, status, party, q, from, to, limit, offset, fields, format; hazard-alerts: type, country, min_level, since, near, source, open, min_magnitude, q, limit, offset, fields, format; sec-filings: form, group, cik, ticker, q, since, limit, offset, fields, format; air-quality: country, pollutant, station, station_type, area, from, to, near, min_mean, min_max, exceedance, complete, limit, offset, fields, format; fuel-prices: country, fuel_type, region, with_taxes, source, from, to, limit, offset, fields, format; electricity-prices: zone, country, source, from, to, limit, offset, fields, format. For free records without filters use get_sample.

dataset.description: Dataset id. amsterdam-events: Amsterdam events; security-advisories: Security advisories; vulnerability-watch: Vulnerability watch; eu-tenders: EU public tenders; uk-tenders: UK public tenders; au-contracts: Australian Government awarded contracts; eu-funding: EU funding calls and grants; us-grants: US federal grant opportunities; cert-advisories: Government CERT security advisories (Europe, UK and US); eu-medicines: EU medicines: authorisations, shortages, safety communications and referrals (EMA); sanctions-entities: Sanctioned entities, vessels and aircraft (EU, OFAC, UK, Canada, Japan and New Zealand lists); product-recalls: Product recalls and safety alerts (US FDA, US CPSC, US NHTSA, Health Canada, Transport Canada, CFIA, UK FSA, UK OPSS, EU Safety Gate, EU RASFF, France RappelConso, Netherlands NVWA, Australia FSANZ, New Zealand MBIE); eu-legislation: EU legislation: new and amended acts in the Official Journal (regulations, directives, decisions); eu-case-law: EU case law: judgments, orders and Advocate General opinions of the Court of Justice and the General Court (metadata); uk-legislation: UK legislation: new and amended Acts and statutory instruments (UK, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland); us-federal-register: US Federal Register: final rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents; drug-shortages: Medicine shortages (US FDA, EMA, Spain AEMPS, France ANSM, Austria BASG); drug-approvals: Medicine approvals (US FDA, Health Canada, UK MHRA); public-holidays: Public and bank holidays (official government lists, current and next year); release-calendars: Official statistics release calendars (Eurostat, ONS, BLS, BEA, US Census Bureau, Statistics Canada, ABS, CBS, SCB, SSB, INE Spain, FOMC, Bank of Canada, Norges Bank, RBA); travel-advisories: Travel advisories (official travel advice levels per destination from the US, UK, Canada, the Netherlands, Japan, France and New Zealand); vat-rates: VAT and GST rates per country, region and category (official, current and historical); exchange-rates: Exchange rates (official daily central bank reference, fixing and indicative rates, two-year history); excise-duties: Excise duty rates on alcohol, tobacco and fuels per country (official, UK, US, New Zealand); customs-tariffs: Import duty rates per commodity code: UK Global Tariff and US HTS (official); bond-yields: Government bond yields and yield curves per issuer, curve type and tenor, daily with full history (official); policy-rates: Central bank policy interest rates: decisions, decision and effective dates, full history (official); company-identifiers: Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI): new and closed legal entities worldwide (GLEIF, last 31 days); company-changes: Company register changes: new, renamed, bankrupt and liquidating companies from official business registers (last 31 days); competition-cases: Competition cases: merger control, antitrust and subsidy control cases and decisions (UK CMA, US FTC early terminations); hazard-alerts: Natural hazard events and official weather and tsunami warnings (USGS, NASA EONET, Copernicus EMS, DWD, ECCC, NOAA); sec-filings: US SEC EDGAR filings by companies (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1, 13D/G, Form D and more), last 30 days; air-quality: Air quality per station and day in Europe: PM2.5, PM10, NO2 and O3 (EEA up-to-date data, last 7 days); fuel-prices: Weekly road fuel prices per country with history: petrol, diesel, LPG and heating oil (EU Weekly Oil Bulletin, UK DESNZ, US EIA); electricity-prices: Day-ahead wholesale electricity prices per bidding zone and hour or 15 minutes (Energinet for Denmark, Germany, Norway and Sweden zones; ERCOT Texas hubs and load zones).

filters.description: Optional filters as name to string value, for example {"country":"NLD","cpv":"72","limit":"5"}. Allowed names per dataset are listed in this description and in list_datasets.

name: query_dataset

http_endpoint.description: GET this URL with an x402 payment to receive the records.

payment_required.description: Always true: the endpoint needs an x402 payment.

x402.description: x402 v1 payment requirements (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo); v2 terms come in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header of the endpoint.
